act_title: The Union Territories (Separation of Judicial and Executive Functions) Act, 1969
title: In sections 127, 128, 129 and 132, for the word “Magistrate”, the words
text:
34. In sections 127, 128, 129 and 132, for the word “Magistrate”, the words

“Executive Magistrate” shall be substituted; in sections 130 and 131, for the words
“a Magistrate” the words “an Executive Magistrate” and in section 131, for the words “no
Magistrate”, the words “no Executive Magistrate” shall be substituted.
